reports.title: CURTISS-WRIGHT REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS AND RAISES FULL-YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is updating its full-year 2026 Adjusted financial guidance(1) as follows:

($ in millions, except EPS) | 2026 Adjusted Non-GAAP Guidance (Prior) | 2026 Adjusted Non-GAAP Guidance (Current) | Change vs 2025 Adjusted (Current)
Total Sales | $3,768 - $3,813 | $3,795 - $3,840 | Up 8 - 10%
Operating Income | $720 - $736 | $731 - $744 | Up 12 - 14%
Operating Margin | 19.1% - 19.3% | 19.2% - 19.4% | Up 60 - 80 bps
Diluted EPS | $15.10 - $15.40 | $15.40 - $15.60 | Up 16 - 18%
Free Cash Flow(2) | $585 - $605 | $595 - $615 | Up 8 - 11%

(1)Reconciliations of Reported to Adjusted 2025 operating results and 2026 financial guidance are available in the Appendix, and exclude first-year purchase accounting costs associated with prior-year acquisitions, costs associated with both our FY24 and FY26 Restructuring Programs, and gains/losses associated with recording equity securities held for investment purposes at fair value.
(2)2026 Free Cash Flow guidance includes higher year-over-year growth in capital expenditures supporting growth and efficiency, and strong free cash flow conversion in excess of 105%.
